summary: Validated backend+frontend regressions for PDF import update. Public API import for the exact supplied JB Jago PDF succeeded (823 tasks, no issues). Backend pytest suite including new JB regression tests passed fully. Import-plan route loads without runtime errors, but headless Playwright could not complete DocumentPicker-driven transition to Review plan.

integration_issues.issue: After three Playwright attempts (filechooser + input[type=file] injection), view did not transition to Review plan in headless mode; no UI error surfaced.

action_items: Physically validate on Android Expo Go that native FormData/fetch path uploads provider URI and reaches Review plan before fallback.
Manually validate web picker interaction in non-headless browser to confirm Review plan transition for the same PDF.
Resolve existing frontend lint failure in app/(tabs)/settings.tsx (react-hooks/set-state-in-effect) to keep CI green.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/import-api.ts correctly sends FormData without manually setting multipart Content-Type and falls back only when native fetch rejects before response.
Env naming drift remains: import-api reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL fallback, while platform guidance references EXPO_BACKEND_URL.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not retry more headless selector permutations for picker flow; loop-prevention reached 3 attempts. Use manual browser/physical Android validation for picker chain.
rca_of_issue: Backend/API path is healthy (exact PDF imports with non-empty tasks and no global issues). Remaining gap is automation limitation around Expo DocumentPicker web/headless event chain; no runtime JS errors were observed on route load.
